01 Events/The Great War/Sections/01 Over.html:
The setting

The Great War › Overview
Summary

The opening months of the First World War, across 1914 Europe.

The Great War is CUE's upcoming modded Minecraft event, taking place on 17 December 2026. It is set in the opening months of the First World War across 1914 Europe, from the Western Front to the Eastern Front.

Players join one of two opposing alliances and take part in an immersive, historically themed conflict built inside Minecraft with custom mods and bespoke systems.

01 Events/The Great War/Sections/01 Over.html:
The format

The Great War › Overview
Summary

A large-scale, coordinated modded event for up to 300 players.

The event is built around realism, immersion and large-scale coordination. Two alliances face off across the European theatre, with developed military systems, period equipment and a custom ruleset.

Applications

Applications open ahead of the event. Join the CUE Discord to be told when registration goes live.

The Great War › Nations
Summary

France, the United Kingdom, Russia and their allies.

The Triple Entente

France, the United Kingdom, Russia and their allied nations.

Entente players represent the allied coalition. Operating on both the Western Front and the Eastern Front, they must coordinate to hold ground, keep their supply lines open and turn the war in their favour.

The Central Powers

Central Powers players command a campaign on several fronts at once. From their central position they must move quickly and decisively, applying pressure before the Entente Powers can consolidate.

General principles

The Great War › Rules
Summary

The standard CUE code of conduct, plus event rules.

All participants are bound by CUE's standard code of conduct, plus event rules.

  • Respect every participant, whatever their faction
  • Follow staff instructions straight away
  • No exploiting bugs, unintended mechanics or out-of-bounds areas
  • Keep the historical atmosphere: this is a curated event
  • No unsanctioned contact with the opposing faction during play
